note: Championship totals for the full life of the league. history.json holds eighteen seasons (2008-2025); the SCFL is older than that, so titles won before the records begin are recorded here from the league's own account. Where a franchise is listed below, that figure is the all-time total and outranks anything counted from history.json. Where it is not listed, only the recorded-seasons count is known and prose must say so.

caveats.finals: All-time title-GAME appearances are not known for any franchise -- only championships. Finals records (e.g. 4-7) are therefore only ever quotable for the eighteen recorded seasons, and must be labelled as such.
caveats.others: Franchises absent from allTimeTitles may also have pre-2008 championships. Never write that a team has never won one, or that anybody leads the league outright, from history.json alone.
